features.note: Thick, dark, strongly arched brows with a high angled peak, consistent with the references.
Light grey almond-shaped eyes, similar color and shape to hers, though they look slightly smaller and more hooded in this lighting.
Nose reads broader at the tip and nostrils, less narrow than her long, slim nose in the references.
Full lips with a defined cupid's bow, closed-mouth smile similar to the references.
Face is broader and rounder with fuller cheeks and a wider jaw. The defined cheekbones and tapered chin of her oval face are softened.
Long black curly hair well past the shoulders, center-ish part, similar to the references.
Curvy hourglass figure in a fitted dress: large full bust, defined waist, wide hips and full thighs, consistent with the full-body panels.

summary: The brows, eyes, hair and figure all match, but the broader, rounder face and wider nose make the candidate read as a similar-looking woman rather than unmistakably Priya Mehta.
